name: Yami
source:
"I will be waiting for you right here... whenever you desire."

The Black Shrine Maiden of Katamiya Shrine.  
She teaches the protagonist how to grant wishes and unites with them to pass on her power as a maiden.  
She appears mature and bewitching, yet is enveloped in an air of mystery.  
She seems fond of the protagonist and actively initiates their union.
